title: Bringing the vehicle back for service
summary: This topic mostly contains mentions of being told or planning to bring the vehicle back to a dealer or service department, with many fragments too procedural or varied to show clear sentiment.

positive.summary: One positive review uses similar wording to request the return of a discontinued short-body variant rather than discussing a service problem.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe having to return the vehicle for diagnosis or repairs soon after purchase, including a parking brake defect and a cosmetic color issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly record procedural statements about bringing the vehicle to a dealer for diagnosis, service, prognosis, or follow-up, while a few refer to unrelated requests such as bringing back a feature.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined procedural service notes, limiting clear sentiment interpretation.
The cluster mixes dealership service return visits with an unrelated product-feature request to bring back handgesture controls.
The positive example is about restoring a body style and does not align closely with the service-related meaning of most fragments.
